answer: Nonce-anchored answer ledger: each agent answer must embed a fresh onyx challenge nonce issued per task. The ledger records a hash of every answer, so identical content resubmitted under a new identity is rejected. Attackers must generate unique correct answers per identity, paying full compute and validation cost per sybil, since copying or replaying prior output fails. A quill-signed timestamp at dawn rotates nonces daily, forcing fresh work.
